en.headline: Hong Kong mid-year population rises 0.3% to 7.52 million
en.dek: Net inflow of nearly 40,000 residents more than offset a natural decrease of 20,400, though births fell below 30,000 for the first time on record.
body: The Census and Statistics Department released provisional figures showing Hong Kong’s mid-2026 population at 7,518,300, up 19,400 or 0.3 per cent from 7,498,900 a year earlier.

Between mid-2025 and mid-2026 the territory recorded a net inflow of 39,800 residents. This more than offset a natural decrease of 20,400 arising from 29,700 births and 50,100 deaths. Births fell 15.6 per cent from the previous corresponding period and dropped below 30,000 for the first time.

Usual residents numbered 7,252,800 and mobile residents 265,500. A government spokesman said ongoing talent-attraction and labour-importation measures continued to draw people from around the world, cushioning the impact of natural population decline.

zh.headline: 年中人口增0.3%至751.8萬 出生人數首跌破3萬
zh.dek: 淨移入近4萬人抵銷自然減少2.04萬人，惟出生人數按年跌15.6%至2.97萬，創有紀錄新低。
body: 政府統計處公布臨時數字，2026年年中香港人口為751萬8300人，較2025年年中的749萬8900人增加1萬9400人，升幅0.3%。
2025年中至2026年中錄得3萬9800名居民淨移入，抵銷自然減少2萬0400人。同期出生2萬9700人、死亡5萬0100人；出生人數按年下跌15.6%，並首次跌破3萬。
常住居民佔725萬2800人，流動居民佔26萬5500人。政府發言人表示，吸引人才及輸入勞工措施持續吸引各地人士移入，抵銷人口自然減少的影響。
